description: Arrival and departures via hamad international airport by month and year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset provides monthly air traffic statistics for Hamad International Airport. It includes the total number of passengers arriving and departing each month, offering insight into travel trends and airport activity over time. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are Hamad Airport, Monthly Traffic, Air Passengers, Qatar Travel. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
